question_text: Discuss one ethical challenge when a distributed social network replicates users’ creative work across independently managed servers.
adaptation_rationale: Rebuilt scenario and response wording while retaining the supported reasoning; source-specific obsolete material excluded.
solution: Replication helps distribute access and avoids dependence on one provider,but it can spread copies beyond the creator’s intended audience or consent. Attribution or deletion requests may not propagate uniformly. Operators need clear consent,attribution and removal practices; decentralization alone does not resolve creators’ rights.
